verdict.rationale: Shopify's own materials show merchant products reaching one kind of external channel: they say merchants can 'sell... in AI chats', and the Global Catalog lets AI agents discover products across the Shopify ecosystem. A shipping page also mentions 'all your sales channels', which implies a multi-channel model, but nothing documents listing or syncing products to marketplaces, social platforms or shopping feeds. Markets covers geographic markets, not channels. Missing for 10: documented marketplace listing/sync, social commerce channels, shopping-feed export, catalog-to-channel sync behavior, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can list and sync products to external channels — marketplaces, social commerce, shopping feeds — from one catalog

citations.quote: Sell online, in person, and in AI chats
enables AI agents to search and discover products across the entire Shopify ecosystem
Orders from all your sales channels in one place
